name: Germany
headline: Engineering Powerhouse & World-Class Public Education
tagline: Study at public and private universities and explore Bachelor’s, Master’s and vocational Ausbildung pathways.
overview: Germany is a premier destination for international students looking for strong academic programs, zero or minimal tuition fees at public universities, diverse career-oriented pathways, and the 18-month post-study job seeker visa.
work_rights: 140 full days or 280 half days / year; 18 months Job Seeker Visa
highlights: Tuition-free or low-cost higher education at world-ranked public universities
Specialized dMAT assessment guidance for Master’s admissions
18-month residence permit post-graduation to find professional employment
Ausbildung (dual vocational training) pathways with paid stipends
Direct pathway to the EU Blue Card and permanent residency

top_universities.name: IU International University of Applied Sciences

name: Austria
headline: High Living Standard in the Heart of Central Europe
tagline: Explore higher education opportunities and pathways for international students.
overview: Austria offers an exceptional quality of life, Vienna consistently ranking as the world’s most livable city. Public universities offer minimal tuition fees and rigorous research standards in tech and business.
work_rights: 20 hrs/week; 12-month post-study Red-White-Red Card job seeker visa
highlights: Vienna ranked repeatedly as the #1 most livable city in the world
Very affordable semester fees for international students
12-month Red-White-Red Card job seeker visa for graduates
Strong research ties with Germany and Central European industries

name: Italy
headline: Heritage of Innovation, Architecture, Design & Tech
tagline: Choose from a wide range of academic programs and universities.
overview: Italy boasts the oldest universities in the Western world alongside cutting-edge polytechnics known for automotive design, civil engineering, robotics, and economics, with generous regional DSU scholarships.
living_cost: €6,000 - €9,000 / year (DSU scholarships can cover full living & fees)
work_rights: 20 hrs/week; 1-year stay-back permit for Masters/PhD graduates
highlights: DSU and regional income-based scholarships covering tuition + stipend
World-famous polytechnics (Politecnico di Milano & Politecnico di Torino)
Rich industrial linkages with Ferrari, Lamborghini, Eni, and Luxottica
Low tuition fee structures for international students

name: Finland
headline: World #1 in Education Quality, Clean Tech & AI Innovation
tagline: Discover high-tech research universities, generous scholarships, and Nordic innovation.
overview: Finland is globally celebrated for world-leading education quality, cutting-edge technology universities, high safety, and a 2-year post-study residence permit for international graduates.
work_rights: 30 hrs/week during term; 2-year post-study work search visa
highlights: Ranked the Happiest Country in the World for 7 consecutive years
Generous university scholarship waivers covering 20% to 100% of tuition
2-year post-study residence permit for graduates to seek employment
Dynamic tech startup and gaming ecosystem (Nokia, Supercell, Slush)

name: Spain
headline: Dynamic International Campuses & Global Business Excellence
tagline: Discover Bachelor’s and Master’s opportunities in an international environment.
overview: Spain combines top-ranked European business schools, affordable tuition fees, and rich cultural heritage. Spanish universities offer an increasing number of fully English-taught programs in tech and business.
work_rights: Up to 30 hrs/week with work authorization; 1-year job seeker visa
highlights: Affordable living costs relative to Western Europe
Home to top 10 global business schools (IE, ESADE, IESE)
Opportunity to learn Spanish, the world’s second most spoken native language
Vibrant startup ecosystems in Barcelona and Madrid

name: Netherlands
headline: High-Tech Innovation & Continental European Business Hub
tagline: Discover internationally recognised programs across technology, business, engineering and other fields.
overview: The Netherlands offers the largest range of English-taught programs in mainland Europe. Known for interactive problem-based learning and strong connections to tech and logistics multinational hubs.
work_rights: 16 hrs/week during study; 1-year Orientation Year (Zoekjaar) visa
highlights: Over 2,100 programs taught entirely in English
1-year Zoekjaar (orientation year) work visa for graduates
World-leading research universities in science, tech, and agriculture
Progressive, safe, and multilingual environment

name: Poland
headline: High-Quality & Highly Affordable European Education
tagline: Explore affordable European education opportunities across multiple disciplines.
overview: Poland has emerged as a favorite study destination for budget-conscious international students, offering affordable tuition, reasonable living expenses, and world-class medical, nursing, and IT faculties.
work_rights: Full-time during holidays, 20 hrs/week; 9-month stay-back for work search
highlights: One of the most cost-effective study destinations in the European Union
Direct admission pathways for Nursing & Healthcare degrees
Rapidly growing tech and IT outsourcing hub in Central Europe
Schengen mobility throughout 29 European countries

name: Latvia
headline: Where Baltic Innovation Meets Academic Value
tagline: Earn an internationally recognised European degree in Riga and beyond.
overview: Latvia offers international students affordable European degrees, prestigious medicine and engineering universities in Riga, and accessible living costs in the euro area.
work_rights: 20 hrs/week during term / full-time in holidays; post-study job search options
highlights: Accessible tuition and living costs in the euro area
Renowned English-medium medical faculties (RSU) and engineering (RTU)
60+ nationalities represented in an international student environment
Member of EU and Schengen zone with modern digital infrastructure

top_universities.name: BA School of Business and Finance

name: Lithuania
headline: Where Baltic Excellence Meets Digital Ambition
tagline: Earn a respected European degree in Vilnius, Kaunas and beyond with exceptional value.
overview: Lithuania offers international students recognized European qualifications, 500+ English-taught programmes, cutting-edge fintech and IT hubs, and remarkably accessible living costs.
work_rights: Up to 40 hrs/week for students with residence permit; 1-year post-study job seeker permit
highlights: Over 500 English-taught programs across universities & applied sciences
Students with residence permit can work up to 40 hours per week
1-year post-study residence permit for eligible graduates
Leading European fintech, laser technology, and life sciences hub
